description: Diffuse, weakly interpretable. Fires mostly in two situations: early openings (4-7 stones) where no stone is in the centre columns 3-4 and stones are spread over the flanks (especially column 1, also 5, 6, 0); or mid-games (about 17+ stones) where column 3 is completely full, mostly with opponent stones, and column 5 is not near full. Almost never fires at 8-16 stones or when the last move was in column 4.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.01.
notes: Layer 0. Five dev-metric calls; best F1 0.233 (P 0.17, R 0.37, AUROC 0.66), sim share 0.67. Activation depends on the whole board (order-invariant except the last move) in a diffuse, non-monotone way: centre stones lower it in openings, but a full column 3 raises it later; strong ply effect (8-16 suppressed). Each earlier stone shifts it 0.1-0.6. No steering effect. Looks like a mixture or random direction; rule is a rough approximation.
